groups.name: namastack.outbox.sns
groups.description: Configuration properties for SNS outbox integration.

properties.name: namastack.outbox.sns.enabled
properties.description: Whether SNS outbox integration is enabled.

properties.name: namastack.outbox.sns.default-topic-arn
properties.description: Default SNS topic ARN for outbox events.

properties.name: namastack.outbox.sns.idempotency-header-enabled
properties.description: Whether to add Idempotency-Key using the persisted record ID unless a route overrides it. Rejects empty or whitespace-only keys when enabled.

properties.name: namastack.outbox.sns.fifo-deduplication-id-enabled
properties.description: Whether to resolve native deduplication IDs for FIFO topics. Uses an explicit SNS deduplication header, then Idempotency-Key, then the persisted record ID. Independent of idempotency-header-enabled.
